nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; per-address token ledger of the UniswapExchange token
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spending approvals, seeded with uint(-1) for the UNI router in the constructor
address private owner; assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and checked by delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress
address tradeAddress; attacker/owner-settable address that bypasses ensure() gating
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist that lets an address transfer without passing condition()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced in condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced in condition()
uint256 private _saleNum; number of transfers allowed per address
uint public totalSupply; minted once in the constructor
string public name; token name set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor
uint constant public decimals = 18; used to scale supplies and sale limits
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; Uniswap router whitelisted in ensure()
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets metadata, mints the whole supply to owner and gives the UNI router unlimited allowance
transfer(address,uint) public payable; simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; checks allowance/ensure/balance then performs unchecked balance updates and increments _onSaleNum
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits on transfers
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public; owner-only setter of _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale using unchecked multiplication
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only loop with unchecked total multiplication and duplicated Transfer events
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; deterministic CREATE2-style Uniswap pair address computation
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used both for authorization (owner checks) and accounting
a.delegatecall(b): low-level delegatecall executing attacker-supplied code in the token storage context
_value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication that can overflow and under-state the required total
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked arithmetic relying only on manual require checks
token*(10**uint256(decimals)): unchecked multiplication in init() that can overflow the sale limits

parameter _value of transfer(), amount to move

parameter _value of transferFrom(), amount transferred
parameter _spender of approve(), allowance beneficiary
parameter _value of approve(), allowance amount
parameter _from of condition(), address whose sale counter is inspected
parameter _value of condition(), amount compared to _minSale/_maxSale
parameter a of delegate(), target contract for the delegatecall
parameter b of delegate(), calldata executed via delegatecall
parameter saleNum of init(), transferred into _saleNum
parameter token of init(), minimum sale amount scaled by decimals
parameter maxToken of init(), maximum sale amount scaled by decimals
parameter _tos of batchSend(), array of recipients
parameter _value of batchSend(), amount sent to each recipient
local total in batchSend(), computed as _value * _tos.length
local loop counter i in batchSend()
local _to loop variable in batchSend()
parameter addr of setTradeAddress(), new whitelisted trade address
parameter factory of pairFor(), Uniswap factory address
parameter tokenA of pairFor()
parameter tokenB of pairFor()
local token0 in pairFor(), lower-ordered token address
local token1 in pairFor(), higher-ordered token address
local pair in pairFor(), computed pair address

parameter _symbol of the constructor
parameter _supply of the constructor, initial supply before decimals scaling

edges.reason: owner = msg.sender in the constructor; whoever deploys becomes the privileged owner
transfer() uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom call
transferFrom() compares msg.sender against _from and consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender, so the caller arbitrarily sets its own allowance
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
init() requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting sale limits
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass distributing balances
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address

_value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom inside transfer()

_value parameter is passed to condition() from ensure()

maxToken parameter is scaled and written into _maxSale by init()

tokenA parameter is ordered against tokenB in pairFor()

transferFrom() writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer

condition() reads _maxSale as the maximum transfer size
